verdict.rationale: Glama documents hosting for MCP servers you have already built: it builds from a GitHub repo, Dockerfile, npm or PyPI package and puts its Gateway in front with no manual proxy wiring. Nothing in the evidence shows it converting an OpenAPI definition, or non-MCP custom code, into an MCP server without the developer writing the protocol layer. Hosting pre-built MCP servers is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
